PRIZES AND ODDS

During the hourly drawing1, a winning two-digit number2 will be selected. Prizes3 and odds vary depending upon the bet type selected.

Bet Type	Prize	Odds
Straight	$60	1 in 100
Box	$30	1 in 50
Front	$6	1 in 10
Back	$6	1 in 10


Overall odds of winning a prize varies upon bet type selected.

DISCLAIMERS:

1 Two To Win can be played from 4:00 AM to 11:59 PM Arizona time, seven days a week, with the first draw time at 4:20 AM and the last drawing at 11:20 PM Arizona time.

2 Lottery numbers broadcasted on television or radio, published on the Arizona State Lottery website, or published and/or communicated by other means does not constitute an official representation of the actual winning lottery numbers. The Arizona State Lottery official audited records of numbers drawn will determine the winning numbers for any draw. A draw game prize must be claimed within 180 days of a drawing.

3 $60,000 prize would be pari-mutuel when the total prize for straight bet with 5X multiplier drawn is above $60,000 – more than 10 max prize winners. The total prize will be split into equal shares, one share for each $1.00 played. The prize amount per share is, $60,000 divided by total winning bets. The prize amount per winner is the prize amount per share times the bet amount.

4 All sales are final. Drawing game tickets cannot be voided.

howToPlay:
HOW TO PLAY
TWO TO WIN
Step 1,
Pick Your Two-Digit Number

Choose Quick Pick and let the computer select the two-digit number for you, or select your own two-digit number:

Two-digit number from 00-99

Choose a bet type: straight (digits match in sequential order), box (both digits match in either order), front digit, or back digit.

Step 2,
Buy Your Ticket

Select your wager - $1, $2, $5, $10 or $20 per play. You also have the option to add Super Bonus for $1 to multiply your prize up to 5X.

Your ticket will print with your numbers on it. 

Quick Draw tickets can be purchased at more than 3,000 Arizona Lottery Retailers.

Step 3,
Check Your Winnings

After the drawing occurs, match the number on your ticket to the winning two-digit number based on your bet type.
